name: Analytics Agent
description: Provides trend detection, forecasting, chart data, statistical analysis, and anomaly detection using PydanticAI and pydantic-graph

skills.name: Trend Detection
skills.description: Detect trend direction, MA crossovers (golden/death cross), and momentum shifts from price data
examples: What is the current trend for AAPL?

skills.name: Price Forecasting
skills.description: 30-day exponential smoothing forecast with confidence bands and MAPE accuracy metric
examples: Forecast NVDA price for the next 30 days
What is the price prediction for MSFT?

skills.name: Chart Data Generation
skills.description: Generate structured candlestick, line, and area chart payloads for frontend rendering

skills.name: Statistical Analysis
skills.description: Compute return distribution, skewness, kurtosis, Jarque-Bera test, and SPY correlation/beta
examples: Run statistical analysis on MSFT returns
What is AAPL's beta to SPY?

skills.name: Anomaly Detection
skills.description: Detect price spikes, volume anomalies, and fundamental outliers using z-score and IQR methods
examples: Detect anomalies in NVDA price data
Are there any volume anomalies for TSLA?
